event.title: ROCKSTAR AND JORDAN BRAND PRESENT: THE LIMITED-EDITION MIDNIGHT CLUB AIR JORDAN II

events.event:
Taking inspiration from the classic Air Jordan II released in 1987, the sneakers are a custom design styled in red and black with the official Midnight Club "Kanji" symbol emblazoned in red on the tongue.

The sneakers come in a custom-made etched acrylic collector's box with a copy of Midnight Club: Los Angeles and together are valued at $380. Only forty pairs will be
manufactured, so fans of Midnight Club Los Angeles and custom kicks should stay on the lookout for chances to win a pair in our upcoming promotions through the
Rockstar Games Social Club, Foot Action Star Club and with our long-standing partners at DUB. For the first word on all contests and promotions, stay tuned here, or sign
up for the Rockstar Games Email List or  RSS feed.

event.title: MIDNIGHT CLUB LOS ANGELES OFFICIAL WORLD CHAMPIONSHIP SERIES

events.event:
Eligible gamers across the globe will now have the chance to battle for supremacy in the Midnight Club: Los Angeles Official World Championship Series. Hosted on the
Rockstar Games Social Club, tournaments will take place throughout 2009 and feature prizes such as gift certificates to the Rockstar Warehouse and rewards from some of
our partners, including a Kawasaki Ninja motorcycle and a year of free pizza from Pizza Hut.

The Rockstar Social Club is the central hub for all tournaments, as well as Rate My Ride, the unlockable Audi R8, and numerous community features for Midnight Club:
Los Angeles. Details on all Social Club events are available at www.rockstargames.com/socialclub/events.

COMPETE IN THE MIDNIGHT CLUB: LOS ANGELES PIZZA HUT SOUTH CENTRAL SHOWDOWN FOR A CHANCE TO WIN A YEAR'S WORTH OF FREE PIZZA.
Register anytime between April 6, 2009 and April 17, 2009, to compete for a chance to win pizza for a year in the next event of the Midnight Club: Los Angeles tournament
series, the Pizza Hut South Central Showdown. Download the free South Central Map Expansion on Xbox LIVE® or PLAYSTATION®Network and visit
www.rockstargames.com/socialclub/tournamentsinfo for more details, and to register for this event.

Once again, Rockstar Games and Midnight Club: Los Angeles are proud to be a part of the annual DUB Show Tour, the world famous custom auto show and concert
series. Swing by any of the 2009 tour stops to play Midnight Club: Los Angeles, the only videogame that features cars customized by DUB, and test drive the
South Central Map Expansion and Premium Upgrade. We'll also be giving away great limited-edition Midnight Club gear, including t-shirts, posters and even remote
controlled cars. See below for tour dates and locations. For tickets and further information, visit www.dubshowtour.com .
